integrity: The finite computation is exact, standard-library reproducible, covers both Frobenius orbits of primitive 14th roots in characteristic 11, and reports no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion concerns principal minors and uses a published lifting theorem plus an exhaustive finite-field certificate; it is not a general proof for all square-free orders.
title: Principal nonsingularity of the order-\(154\) Fourier matrix
